plan.title: USD and INR bid currency support

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen described by the case.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Every create flow requires a title before publication.
Apply the RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add one line item as the closest available substitute for selecting the requested CYLINDER product.
Populate the available pricing sheet fields.
Invite two QA vendors to approximate Vendor A and Vendor B without inventing their names.
Publish the RFQ so a vendor can submit a quote.
Confirm publication reached a real event page.
Move to the available invited QA vendor portal session.
Open the event's RFQ pricing sheet in the vendor portal.
Submit the numeric 1.2 quote as the closest available representation of the requested USD bid.
Confirm the vendor portal accepted the quote.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Close the published event so the buyer comparison can be opened.
Open the buyer's Master QCS and assert that the comparison grid rendered with the submitted bid.
Confirm the buyer comparison contains a real vendor column for the submitted quote.
